text: I presume you know that in any business whatever, people are more apt to follow the lead of those whom they look upon as adepts; thus in case of sickness they are readiest to obey him whom they regard as the cleverest physician; and so on a voyage the most skilful pilot; in matters agricultural the best farmer, and so forth.... he who is looked upon as knowing his business best will command the readiest obedience.
author: Xenophon
speaker: Socrates
